authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.1 and 20.4.68
scope: Compare physically observed DIMSTYLE on the locally generated ODA AC1012 source/destination pair with their existing ODA DXF reopens.
checks: The shared version-aware DIMSTYLE observer binds both ODA-generated DWG frames, including their absolute role-4 control owner, non-null extension 0x1E1, null xref and role-5 STYLE 0x30. Their selected body values match the earlier LibreDWG-generated pair; wrong roles and all byte-prefix truncations are rejected and original-frame retry passes.

In both ODA-generated DWGs, DIMSCALE=1, DIMASZ=0.18, DIMTXT=0.18, DIMEXO=0.0625 and DIMTIH=1. The existing ODA 27.10 DXF reopens give 1, 2.5, 2.5, 0.625 and 0 respectively; ezdxf 1.4.5 reports zero audit errors or fixes. Independent LibreDWG decoding reports the same selected source values.

The locally authored input DXFs for both ODA-generated drawings already contain the same 2.5, 2.5, 0.625 and 0 values as the ODA reopens. The intervening AC1012 DWG wire instead contains 0.18, 0.18, 0.0625 and 1; matching input/output DXF alone therefore does not demonstrate preservation of these fields through DWG.

Thus the observed difference is not confined to a LibreDWG-produced DWG. The ODA-profile handoff now warns about the discrepancy; the populated-pair observer remains unchanged on its original frames. No drawing fixture was committed.
limits: This is a source-wire and output comparison, not proof of the cause of conversion differences, native AutoCAD behavior, whole-file fidelity or dictionary cloning semantics.
The non-null extension target and the remaining ODA-source graph still require separate closure.
